items.en: Reference course files with @, and use several skills in one message with /.
items.zh: 可以用 @ 引用课程文件，一条消息里也能用 / 选择多个技能。

items.en: Change several assessments at once: tick them to set a category or weight, split a total weight evenly, drop them from the grade, or delete them.
items.zh: 可以一次修改多项考核：勾选后统一设置分类或权重、平分总权重、不计入成绩，或一起删除。

items.en: Selecting rows in tables is smoother and works the same way everywhere, with Clear selection next to the batch actions.
items.zh: 表格多选更流畅，各处的操作方式一致，“取消选择”放在批量操作旁边。

items.en: Fixed the loading screen with a collapsed sidebar and icon alignment in settings dropdowns.
items.zh: 修复侧边栏收起时的加载画面，以及设置下拉菜单中图标未对齐的问题。

items.en: Exported timetable images and PDFs now carry the Semestra mark.
items.zh: 导出的课表图片和 PDF 现在带有 Semestra 标识。

items.en: File preview now supports custom zoom levels and Ctrl/⌘ + scroll zoom, and wide tables no longer overflow.
items.zh: 文件预览支持自定义缩放比例和 Ctrl/⌘ + 滚轮缩放，宽表格不再溢出。
